cc:Work.dc:description: Required independent effective force and wheel-power capacities for an ideal 2000 kg rest-to-60-mph launch in one second. Force cap must be at least 53.6448 kN. At that cap, 1.438882 MW is needed; with 70 kN, 876.075 kW suffices using varying acceleration. The current assumed 1200 Nm motor is not held fixed: both grip and torque force must support C. Baseline and zero-cost downforce/G12 combination are below the force requirement.
